title: Ashbury Rewards Points Ledger: Largest Transfer an Account Allows
content:
The largest number of points an Ashbury Rewards member can give to another member in one transfer rests on the definitions below.

## Definitions

**L1 — Largest transfer.** A member who asks to give another member the largest transfer their account allows gives, in one transfer, the lower of the transferable balance and the remaining transfer allowance, rounded down to a multiple of the tier's points transfer increment.

**L2 — Transferable balance.** The transferable balance is the points balance less the points received by transfer in the 12 months before the handling date and less the points bought in the 3 months before the handling date, never below zero.

**L3 — Transfer allowance.** The transfer allowance is the points transfer out annual cap of the sender's tier.

**L4 — Allowance used.** The allowance used is the points the member transferred out in the twelve months before the handling date.

**L5 — Remaining transfer allowance.** The remaining transfer allowance is the transfer allowance less the allowance used, never below zero.

**L6 — Periods.** A period of months before the handling date covers the transactions posted after the same day number that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

## Worked figure (hypothetical member)

| Line | Value |
|---|---|
| Points balance | 64300 |
| Received by transfer in the 12 months | 10000 |
| Bought in the 3 months | 5000 |
| Transferable balance (L2) | 49300 |
| Transfer-out cap of the tier, taken as | 100000 |
| Transferred out in the 12 months (L4) | 70000 |
| Remaining transfer allowance (L5) | 30000 |
| Lower of the two | 30000 |
| Transfer increment of the tier, taken as | 500 |
| Largest transfer (L1) | 30000 |

Had the transferable balance been 29800, the lower figure would be 29800, rounded down to 29500.
